payload.body: hv, directly to ic (19 Oct, after the compact): 'Just do the same thing that Gtools does!' and 'I want it to _work_ and I want to stop stuffing around fixing a problem that is already solved.' hv's screenshot of the diagnostic answered the look: neither row draws, though both hold a good 32 by 32 image. Gtools' GtoolsApp.drawsImage sets NSMenuItem preferredImageVisibility to .visible (by key; macOS 27 hides item images by default, found 15 Sep). Menuz never did. I'm doing what hv asked: the same function in MenuzMasthead.row (wt-0073g at 805b2707, 1 file), menuz test, landing by path, then restore-install from main's head, which also removes the diagnostic. Stop me if you need to.
